newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 6.907 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 6.907 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 105-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.907 percent versus 7.04 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 189-day treasury bills was 7.118 percent versus 7.2 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 413-day treasury bills was 7.555 percent versus 7.538 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
